basis: Alice surfaces on the glass_table_legs anchor at (0.60, -0.30), 0.61 m high and treading water: her foot anchor sits at y -0.42 so her chin is exactly on the 0.10 m water surface and only her head and shoulders are above it, which is what both shots frame. She faces the east-wall door bases (yaw 0.2349, computed from her position to the east_doors landmark); on the tile-5 axis screen-right is -Z, so those door bases read screen-left with her lead room open on that side, as composition requires. She does not move in either shot - she comes up spluttering, licks the salt off her lips at t=2.0, and works the problem out aloud through sh095.
warnings: Both lenses sit at 0.05 m, just under the 0.10 m surface line, so the waterline cuts the frame exactly where camera.json asks.
The three glass table legs at (0.00, 0.00) are the only obstacles in the swim area and she surfaces 0.67 m clear of them.
S10 lenses are set at 0.13 m, just above the 0.10 m modelled water slab, rather than camera.json's 0.05 m: at 0.05 m the lens sits inside the water volume and the waterline does not read at all.

issues.question: SCN-pool-of-tears models the flood at its true 0.10 m depth (four inches). S10 needs a 0.61 m Alice to surface, tread water and swim in it, which 0.10 m cannot hold; the size chain licenses an x12 tank build for these beats but the whitebox scene is the true-scale one. Sink her below the modelled floor, or have the pool re-modelled at swimming depth?
issues.provisional: Drop her foot anchor to y -0.42 so her chin sits on the 0.10 m surface and only head and shoulders show. The waterline, her visible fraction and every camera height are then correct; she is simply 0.42 m below the modelled floor plane in the spatial view.

options.label: Sink the swimmer below the modelled floor (the default)
options.consequence: Camera views are correct; the spatial/top view shows her standing through the floor of the model.

options.label: Have p4-scene-model give SCN-pool-of-tears a swimming-depth water volume for S10
options.consequence: grp035-grp037 re-staged on a real water body; the scene then disagrees with the four-inch flood the S08/S09 gauges use.

sources.quote: swim_area: Water x 0-0.85, y 0.3067-0.6933 (28 m x 7.2 m), 0.1 m deep at true scale.
the S10 swim beats are shot on an x12 tank build (SCN-pool-of-tears layout scale_note)
